Choose your usual home app here. Media Home stays installed and can be chosen again.

Android usually mixes and resamples USB audio itself, so bit-perfect playback needs a player with its own USB driver.

Player Pure (the Music tile): connect the DAC, let Android open Player Pure for it and tick "Always". Player Pure › Settings shows the DAC, and Now Playing says "Bit-perfect". Leave Digital volume off and set the level on the DAC or amplifier.

HiBy Music also works: let HiBy use the DAC, then turn on exclusive USB output in its settings, with EQ, MSEB and effects off.

Check: the DAC's sample-rate display should follow each track (44.1 kHz, 96 kHz and so on). Only one app can hold the DAC at a time.
Settings and DAC test are in Player Pure \u203a Settings

Screen saver: clock, weather and music
In Android\'s screen saver settings choose Media Home clock and \"While charging\". It starts only while the device is charging.
Lets Settings › Screen saver › Start after change Android\'s screen timeout.
Android\'s page for this app: permissions, and ⋮ › Allow restricted settings
Step-by-step help in English and Vietnamese (opens a web page)
Go to the home screen. Anything left can be done later.
Paste your own key below. To protect it, restrict it in Google Cloud Console: Android apps, package name %1$s, SHA-1 %2$s; API restriction: YouTube Data API v3.
On: after %1$d min without use, the tablet shows the clock, the weather and the music that is playing instead of turning the screen off.
Off: Android\'s screen saver is not set to Media Home. Tap \"Android screen saver settings\" below, choose Media Home clock and \"While charging\".
Android doesn\'t say which screen saver is chosen. If it is Media Home clock, it starts after %1$d min without use.
It starts only while the tablet is plugged in (Android\'s rule); on battery the screen turns off as usual. Touch the screen to go back to what was open.
\"Stay awake while charging\" is on (in Developer options), so the screen never times out and the screen saver can\'t start. Turn it off there.
\"Keep the screen on\" (above) keeps the screen on while the home screen is showing, so the screen saver starts only from other apps.
